name: car_4sigma_300_6000_negative
rationale: Across three disjoint 1 s windows on IBL insertion 4836a465, median-CAR plus a 300–6000 Hz cascade and 4σ negative threshold had the most stable 1 ms F1 versus sorting without the false-positive inflation of dual polarity. A 9 kHz low-pass was statistically similar; the 6 kHz cut is frozen because it matches the existing hardware IIR band. Six-sigma after CAR remains too conservative on the harder windows. RTL does not follow: the frozen path requires median CAR before the threshold comparison, and that stage is not in the current SystemVerilog pipeline. Offline 4σ registers could be loaded only after CAR.
selection_evidence: reports/ibl-detection-localization.json detector_variants at 1 ms vs sorting
rtl_reason: Median CAR is required before the frozen 4σ comparison and is not present in rtl/neurosig_pipeline.sv. Changing only the offline threshold registers without CAR would not reproduce this Python detector.
hardware_note: A later RTL revision could add a median-CAR stage, then load 4σ MAD registers.
